info.title: Auth Service API
info.description: A RESTful API for managing Authentication and User Management

post.summary: Generates a new primary or secondary API key for the tenant. The previous key of the same type will be invalidated. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

requestBody.description: Request containing the type (primary or secondary)

get.summary: Retrieves both the primary and secondary API keys for the current tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

post.summary: Exchanges an API key (provided in X-API-Key header) for a JWT token. This endpoint is publicly accessible and used for API key authentication.
OAuth2 token endpoint that handles authorization code and refresh token grant types. Returns access tokens and refresh tokens for authenticated users.
Initiates a password reset flow by sending a reset token to the user's email address. This endpoint is publicly accessible.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Page access token from query string (required for security)

requestBody.description: Forgot password request containing username. tenantId is extracted from the path: /tenant/{tenantId}/{_authServiceVersion}/Auth/forgot-password

post.summary: Generates a one-time reset token for authenticated users. Requires JWT bearer token authentication. Returns a reset token with 30 second expiry in the response. Each call creates a new token in the database.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID from the route path: /tenant/{tenantId}/{_authServiceVersion}/Auth/one-time-token

get.summary: Reset Password endpoint - validates token when user clicks link from email and shows password reset form

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Password reset token from email link

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID from the route path: /tenant/{tenantId}/{_authServiceVersion}/Auth/reset-password

post.summary: OAuth2 Client Registration Endpoint (RFC 7591) Allows third-party clients to register and obtain client_id/client_secret

get.summary: OAuth2 Authorization Endpoint (RFC 6749 Section 4.1.1) Standard redirect-based authorization flow for third-party clients
OpenID Connect UserInfo Endpoint (OIDC Core Section 5.3) Returns user profile information based on the access token

post.summary: OAuth2 Token Introspection Endpoint (RFC 7662) Returns metadata about a token, including whether it is active
OAuth2 Token Revocation Endpoint (RFC 7009) Revokes an access token or refresh token
Revokes all refresh tokens for a specific user within the tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

parameters.name: post_logout_redirect_uri

parameters.name: state

parameters.name: tenantId

parameters.name: id_token_hint
parameters.description: Optional ID token to identify the user session

parameters.name: post_logout_redirect_uri
parameters.description: Optional URI to redirect to after logout

parameters.name: state

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID from the route path

get.summary: OpenID Connect Discovery Endpoint (OIDC Discovery Section 4) Returns metadata about the OIDC provider
OpenID Connect JWKS Endpoint (OIDC Core Section 10) Returns public keys for verifying ID token signatures Uses RS256 (asymmetric) signing - public key is safely exposed

Paged tenant auth audit from AuthService.Models.UserLoginHistory (object type 22). Requires startDateAndTime (UTC lower bound for `attemptedAt`, inclusive). Optional activityType: omit or empty defaults to interactive logins only (same as `login`); `refresh` for refresh-grant audit only; `both` for all rows. Other optional filters: userId (user document id / GUID, or the user's email in this tenant — resolved to id for filtering), exact ipAddress, and success (true = successes only, false = failures only). Requires a JWT whose `groups` claim includes the tenant administrator group.
Retrieves authentication settings for the current tenant including token expiry, login methods, and custom HTML pages. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

put.summary: Updates authentication settings for the current tenant including token expiry times, login methods, allowed origins, and custom HTML pages. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of all groups in the current tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

post.summary: Creates a new group in the current tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

get.summary: Retrieves details for a specific group by its ID. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

put.summary: Updates an existing group's name and description. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

delete.summary: Deletes a group from the tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

post.summary: Adds a member (user) to a group. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of members (users) in a group. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

delete.summary: Removes a member (user) from a group. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of all users in the current tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

post.summary: Creates a new user account in the current tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

get.summary: Retrieves details for a specific user by their user ID. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

put.summary: Updates an existing user's information including email, display name, password, and enabled status. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

delete.summary: Deletes a user from the tenant. Cannot delete yourself or the last admin user. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of groups that a user belongs to. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication, or the user can query their own groups.
Retrieves a paginated list of all workspaces in the current tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

post.summary: Creates a new workspace in the current tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

get.summary: Retrieves details for a specific workspace by its ID. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

put.summary: Updates an existing workspace's name, description, and enabled status. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

delete.summary: Deletes a workspace from the tenant. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication. Note: This will fail if there are users assigned to this workspace. Users must be reassigned first.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of members (users) in a workspace. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

post.summary: Adds a member (user) to a workspace by updating the user's workspaceId. Requires Admin privileges or API Key authentication.

secondaryApiKey.description: The secondary API key (may be null if not set)

tenantId.description: The tenant ID these keys belong to

mfaMethod.description: MFA delivery: 'authenticatorApp' or 'email'. Ignored when RequireTOTP is false.

fields.description: Optional dynamic key-value pairs; parameter names and values may vary per record. Same approach as Workflow Service: values may be JsonElement from API deserialization.

type.description: The type of API key to generate: 'primary' or 'secondary'

GenerateApiKeyResponse.description: Response model for API key generation

LoginHistoryItemResponse.description: One AuthService.Models.UserLoginHistory row for tenant-admin GET login-history; AuthService.Models.LoginHistoryItemResponse.ActivityType reflects interactive login vs refresh audit.

token.description: The reset token that can be used for password reset

expiresAt.description: The expiration date/time of the token in ISO 8601 format

expiresIn.description: The expiration time in seconds (30 seconds)

OneTimeTokenResponse.description: Response model for one-time token generation

mfaMethod.description: MFA delivery: 'authenticatorApp' or 'email'. Changing this clears the existing MFA secret and pending email challenge.

fields.description: Optional dynamic key-value pairs; parameter names and values may vary per record. Same approach as Workflow Service: values may be JsonElement from API deserialization.

UserListItemResponse.description: Response model for user data in paginated lists (GET Users and GET Groups Members). Contains a subset of user fields optimized for list views.

UserResponse.description: Response model for user data exposed through API endpoints. Sensitive fields (password, salt, totpSecret) are intentionally excluded for security.

fields.description: Dynamic key-value pairs; parameter names and values may vary per record. Same approach as Workflow Service: plain types for correct API serialization.
